claims.title: Complete bounded sampler
claims.english_claim: One fixed public fair-bit machine halts with a feasible table on every random tape by a global polynomial time C*S^D; at that same time its output law has total variation at most 2^-h from uniform ordinary fixed-margin tables.
claims.quantity: Every-tape time ≤ C Sᴰ; total variation ≤ 2⁻ʰ
hypotheses: Any finite dimensions m,n and natural margins r:Fin m→ℕ,c:Fin n→ℕ with equal ordinary totals; zero margins and empty dimensions are included.

Numeric precision h≥1; M=∑ᵢrᵢ and S=m+n+clog₂(M+1)+h+1. One fixed machine and natural C>0,D apply uniformly to all inputs. Accuracy uses independent uniform fair bits; feasibility holds for every tape.
limitations: The numerical complete runtime degree D has not been extracted; d¹⁷ is an inverse-gap power and S¹⁷⁰ bounds reserved bits/input size, not complete machine time.
Practical sampler performance and strict Comparator acceptance of this sampler remain unknown. This bounded near-uniform theorem supplies no exact-sampling or counting extension.
